ABOUT THIS VEHICLE

Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami is delighted to offer this 2026 Lamborghini Urus SE for sale!

Powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0L V8 paired with a high-performance electric motor, the Urus SE produces an astonishing 789 horsepower and 701 lb-ft of torque. Its plug-in hybrid powertrain delivers breathtaking acceleration with a 0–62 mph time of just 3.4 seconds and a top speed of 194 mph, while also offering more than 37 miles of all-electric driving capability. Advanced all-wheel drive, rear-wheel steering, active torque vectoring, adaptive air suspension, and selectable drive modes provide exceptional agility and control across virtually any road. The Urus SE's sculpted bodywork, aggressive proportions, distinctive lighting, and unmistakable Lamborghini design create the commanding presence expected from a true Super SUV. Inside, the cabin combines premium Italian craftsmanship, luxurious materials, advanced technology, and a driver-focused environment that makes the Urus SE equally suited for everyday driving or spirited weekend adventures.

Contact Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami to make this Urus SE yours today. Sales Price includes dealer fee of $1447.50 and $299 electronic filing fee. Tax, tag, title and registrations fees are not included and are calculated at time of purchase.
